posts.name: SeraAlexandria
posts.cooked: They play exactly as the cards say they play. They get their own turns immediately after hers. Of course, she can only ever have one out in a turn, and since you can't replace the card you pick up, would have to wait a turn after their incapacitation to replay them.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
SeraAlexandria:

since you can't replace the card you pick up, would have to wait a turn after their incapacitation to replay them. 

Actually, since Citizens have their own turn, this will allow them to stand up from Incapacitation on their turn, rather than having to take the card back and playing it at another time. However you would still need to do so if you want to switch Citizens.

posts.name: lutherbellhendricksv
posts.cooked:
Ronway:

 

SeraAlexandria wrote:
since you can't replace the card you pick up, would have to wait a turn after their incapacitation to replay them.   
Actually, since Citizens have their own turn, this will allow them to stand up from Incapacitation on their turn, rather than having to take the card back and playing it at another time. However you would still need to do so if you want to switch Citizens.

Only characters remain on the board when incapacitated. Note the Citizen Dawn scenarios that specify that the Citizens in those scenarios break this rule.
